row.name: Invasion Zero
row.detailed_description: Invasion Zero is a multi-player online free to play first-shooter game supporting up-to 8 players per single session where you are able to play against enemy AI bots or players from all over the world. As the main player, you are equipped with a machine gun, shotgun, or sniper rifle depending on your class with a gun and a knife and a hand grenade. Your main objective is to survive the battle as much as possible while destroying the spawning enemy forces. The game contains several playable modes such as: 1- Team Deathmatch (TDM) 2- Free-for-all (FFA) 3- Capture The Flag (CTF) 4- Gun Race (GR) 5- Domination / Cover Point (CP) 6- Search and Destroy (SND) 7- Elimination 8- Demolition The game contains violence through ranged and melee weaponry piercing through the body of the enemy players.
row.short_description: Invasion Zero is a multi-player online free to play first-shooter game where you are able to play against enemy AI bots or players from all over the world.
row.notes: Invasion Zero is a free to play multi-player first-person shooter game including many modes such as Team Deathmatch, Capture the flag, Free-for-all etc..

row.name: De Profundis
row.detailed_description: Après une mystérieuse explosion au sein du centre commercial Grasseille, Daniel se réveille au milieu des débris, dans le noir complet. Il rencontre d’autres survivants et, ensemble, ils cherchent une voie de sortie. Mais les sous-sols dans lesquels ils sont tombés sont étrangement vastes, et tous les dangers semblent possibles. Surtout ceux qu'on ne peut pas voir. _________________________________ De Profundis est construit comme un visual novel, mais se passe intégralement dans le noir. Le son y est essentiel. En particulier, les paroles des personnages sont mises en musique, chacun avec son instrument propre. En fonction des choix du joueur, son lien avec chaque personnage grandit. Lorsque ce lien est au maximum, Daniel, artiste peintre, imagine un tableau le représentant. Plusieurs fins sont possibles. La vraie fin du jeu arrive lorsque suffisamment de tableaux sont débloqués. Il faut compter environ 8 heures pour terminer le jeu avec sa vraie fin.
row.short_description: Un visual novel d’horreur qui se déroule dans le noir complet, où les paroles des personnages sont mises en musique.

row.name: Sick Love - An RPG Maker Novel
row.detailed_description: A short visual novel about Miguel, a boy whose dream is finding love, Fernando, a boy who seems to be an enchanted prince, and Júlio, a young man who falls in love with both of them. Created on 'RPG Maker', you'll watch how these three boys get to know each other, fall in love and how a tragedy marks this unique relationship. Features: A visual novel about the relationship of three young boys; Can be completed in one session (Playtime approximately 20 minutes - including all finals); Four different endings; A game without a fight; Simple and easy gameplay;
row.short_description: A short and exciting visual novel about gaymers. Live the desire to be loved, learn how a relationship is capable of hurting you and how this can result in a tragedy. All your decisions have consequences.
row.notes: Abusive relationship, psychological and physical violence in some scenes of the game.

row.name: Microwasp Seekers
row.detailed_description: Seekers is a frantic action game about your computer's internal battle between defragmenting BeeBots and data writing AntBots. Or... you can sit back and relax to the chill soundtrack while you organize file segments into complete files. Pilot a BeeBot and keep the Seeker Mothership happy by keeping the drive nice and organized. Your favorite user just got a new hard drive with lots of space for activities! Help her out by keeping files organized for fast access by the Seeker. To do this, you'll need to pick up scattered file segments and place them. Here's a free tip: the Seeker can read a file faster if a file's segments are adjacent! Features: Frantic... or meditative defragmenting gameplay Reassemble file fragments for the Seeker while the hard drive fills up Explore the astonishing pixel art of the Microwasp desktop environment Put yourself in the computer with a groovy synthwave inspired environment A boppin soundtrack! Round and round she goes, good old Seeker MotherShip, collecting data. That's her job. But she can't do her job properly if its all mixed up. That's where we come in, the BeeBots. Yes, you too, once you download this game, you're one of us. Welcome to the team, happy days and all that, now lets get to work. The AntBots deliver the data, you'll see them flying around and randomly dropping pods here and there. That won't do. They need to be lined up neatly, all the file fragments with the same name, in one continuous line OK? It's not difficult really, you'll soon get the idea. If you mess it up, well, don't worry, we've all been there. New on the job, it's normal. Restart, try again. You got this. Once you get to my level, you'll start organizing them in successive order (you know 1.. 2.. 3..). Then you will know the true satisfaction of a job well done. Seeker MotherShip might not praise you, she for sure wont actually, but the speed, oh the speed. Now go gettem' BeeBot, you can do it, I almost believe in you.
row.short_description: Pilot a BeeBot and keep the Seeker Mothership happy by defragmenting a constantly filling hard drive to chill synthwave beats!

row.name: The Polynesian Cultural Center VR Experience
row.detailed_description: Have you ever wondered what it's like to spend the day at the Polynesian Cultural Center - Hawaii's #1 paid attraction - on the North Shore of Oahu? Experience each of the Center's amazing Polynesian villages, the incredible evening show Ha: Breath of Life, our beautiful mid-day canoe show Huki!, and our delightful Ali'i Luau Dinner Show in full 3D/360 VR. This experience will give you just a taste of what you will find when you visit the Polynesian Cultural Center on your next trip to the beautiful island of Oahu.

row.name: Myths and Legends - Card Game
row.detailed_description: Myths & Legends Online With over 17 years on the market, the real-life Trading Card Game Mitos y Leyendas has been a solid alternative to play with friends. Gameplay In simple steps: Select a Demo Deck Wait for another player to join you Play your cards Destroy their Castle Currently with 260 unique cards in just a few (for now) Demo Decks, you can play with anyone else connected in real time. Careful with what damage you choose to take, because your Castle is your deck; each point of damage you take is a card that goes straight to your Graveyard. Features 260 cards at the moment, with more than 6000 in development (see IRL cards). 4 Demo Decks for you to try a small portion of the archetypes you will be able to play in M&L. Build your own deck and strategy.** Customize your battlefield; be an European medieval Queen/King, an Egyptian Pharaoh… or a Viking? You can customize the look of your battlefield as you wish.** Transmute your cards to create new ones and experience more exciting abilities.** **: Feature still on development Card Types Allies are warrior cards used to defend your Castle-Deck or to attack your opponent's Castle. An Ally cannot attack unless it has been in play for at least one turn. However, you can always use it to either block or activate its abilities. Totems are cards that grant specific abilities. The card's abilities can usually be activated as long as the Totem remains in the battlefield. Talismans are one-time use cards with specific effects. Weapons are equipped by Allies already in play. Only one Weapon may be attached to an Ally at any time, and once attached to an Ally, a Weapon cannot be removed or transferred to another Ally. They usually provide a Strength bonus and/or an effect. Gold cards are the resource used by players to play cards. Players begin the game with one Gold Card in play, and can add a gold card to their Gold Reserve each turn. ----- Battle other Guardians online leading your favorite mythological, historical and literary characters in this adaptation of the popular TCG game Myths and Legends. Collect the cards, build the perfect strategy and crush your enemies, share your triumphs and win amazing prices. Myths and Legends Online.
row.short_description: Battle other Guardians leading your favorite mythological, historical and literary characters in this adaptation of the popular TCG game Myths and Legends. Collect the cards, build the perfect strategy and crush your enemies.

row.name: Retro Space Shooter
row.detailed_description: This game is ad-free. IMPORTANT - This game is an in-development Alpha (pre-Beta) release status. It will contain bugs and some imbalanced game play. Many planned features are not yet implemented and will be released over time. Planned features and game balance will change over time. The current price for this app is based on the 'in-development, Alpha release' status. The Beta and full release versions of this game will be released at higher prices. If you purchase this Alpha release, you will be automatically granted access to any future Beta release (when available), as well as the final full release version (when available). Retro Space Shooter is a refreshingly modern 3D physics-based implementation of a top-down retro arcade space shooter. Expertly pilot your drone ship through an onslaught of enemy fire and fight seemingly endless waves of enemy ships and bosses. Adapt your tactics as the battles become tougher, and upgrade your ships engines, weapons, and shields to power through tough foes. The game is simple to play yet fiendishly difficult at higher levels as you dodge hundreds of plasma bolts, missiles, and other enemy weapons, all while trying to keep your shots focused on ships long enough to kill them. Collect debris fields to earn credits and power ups to enhance your ship along the way. Spend your credits to permanently upgrade your existing systems, or buy new weapons and defenses to install on your ship. Use the back button to head back to your star base (main menu) to refit your ship without losing progress, but avoid death at all costs if you want to keep those power ups you collected along the way. For the power-hungry among you, keep upgrading those plasma weapons and you will soon find yourself shooting coherent plasma beams capable of converting your enemies to a pile of debris in mere moments. But beware the enemy firing a coherent plasma beam at you!
row.short_description: Retro Space Shooter is a refreshingly modern 3D physics-based implementation of a top-down retro arcade space shooter. Expertly pilot your drone ship through an onslaught of enemy fire and fight seemingly endless waves of enemy ships and bosses.

row.name: Cantrip Cafe
row.detailed_description: DESCRIPTION Cantrip Cafe is a zany, zesty restaurant game where you and your friends play as spell-casting witches to not only serve your customers, but protect them from a horde of hungry monsters. Gain access to a variety of magical spells, both offensive and defensive. Upgrade your spells to unleash devastating attacks on enemies, or upgrade your store to expedite your food service. You can also team up with up to 3 friends, and when you’re done running the cafe together, you can fight against each other in versus mode. FEATURES -A unique spin on the cooking and beat ‘em up genres -Local Multiplayer, up to 4 players -Cooperative Mode and Competitive Mode -Self adjusting difficulty -Variety of spell types for different gameplay styles -Upgrade System with 6 devastating ultimate spells -Short play sessions -Easy to jump into! -Steam Achievements
row.short_description: Cantrip Cafe is a zany, zesty restaurant game where you and your friends play as spell-casting witches to not only serve your customers, but protect them from a horde of hungry monsters.

row.name: BubbleGum-Push
row.detailed_description: Simple, Challenging, Fun, and Free! Fight your way to the top of a cute little gum-ball-machine! A simple and cozy game that will have you hooked in an effort to win prize after prize! Ladies....Gentlemen: BubbleGum-Push! Hit the balls you want. Avoid the ones don't. Each different color gum-ball can be either good or bad, depending on the situation. Prepare to have your quick thinking abilities put to the test, by the ever more increasing difficulty of the cute little candy coated balls of BubbleGum-Push! DISCLAIMER: Do not swallow the bubble-gum!!! The goal is to score EXACTLY the given amount of points. Therefore, you must choose which color balls you need to collect in order to win. If you need to score more points to reach the goal amount, then collect the Green, Blue, and Purple balls. If you need to lose a few points instead, then collect the Yellow, Red, and Orange balls. There are also special balls, that do awesome things, which can either help or hurt you. Teleportation, Anti-Gravity, and Color-Inversion are some of the many magical things, that will keep you on your toes, throughout 240 levels of the coolest casual game around! Balls: - Shed Red -- Takes away 3pts. - Lean Green -- Adds 1pt. - Blue Two -- Adds 2pts. - Yellow Shmellow -- Takes away 1pt. - Purple Jumper -- Adds 3pts if you jump to collect him. - Orange Jumper -- Takes away 3pts unless you stay low to avoid him. - Black Mamba -- Changes the color of all the balls behind him. - White Lightning -- Teleports you back to the bottom for a fresh start. - Gravity Gray -- Makes all the balls stick to the top. More balls are coming soon! Enjoy ;)

A 360° musical Virtual Reality safe-space, where we can leave our hectic, busy lives for a moment and enter a world where you experience a place of melodic tranquility A place to disconnect for a little while and feel childlike wonder SZEN was developed as a VR Experience for the HTC VIVE. row.short_description: 'The Symphony of Mysteries!' SZEN is a musical Virtual Reality safe-space, where we can leave our hectic, busy lives for a moment and enter a world where you experience a place of melodic tranquility and wonder. Sit back, relax, let SZEN take you away!

row.name: TankDestruction
row.detailed_description: TankDestruction is a fast-paced multiplayer action game. Equip the abilities you wish to use, and join the battle on large-scale maps with up to 20 other players! To win, capture the towers controlled by the enemy team - but be careful, as they are protected by powerful AI-controlled turrets which have to be destroyed first. Spend too long destroying them, and enemy tiger tanks will start to swarm all over you - they enjoy derping around, but they'll destroy you all the same! When duelling other players, you rely on your speed to survive, so try not to crash into a tree! You'll look a bit silly (and a bit helpless) if you do. TankDestruction is free to play. For those who wish to support the game, there is an option to purchase a premium account which provides cosmetic bonuses only , such as being able to equip different skins. Controls: Use WASD to move. Left click to fire the main gun - this is your long-range weapon. Right click to fire the machine guns - these guns are only effective at short range. Use the 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 buttons to activate your special abilities. Hold the W key if your tank is stuck upside-down. Protips: Destroy two or more turrets before attacking the tower. Driving faster will allow you to dodge bullets. Your bullets will automatically lock onto the closest target near the centre of your screen.
row.short_description: TankDestruction is a multiplayer game with a focus on fast-paced action. Select 5 special abilities and battle on large-scale maps with up to 20 other players! Destroy tiger tanks, other players, and automated turrets that stand in your way, to capture enemy towers and win the game!

row.name: Refight:The Last Warship
row.detailed_description: Refight: The Last Warship is a 3D tactical warship arena TPS developed and published by Wuxi Brahma. A huge sandbox powered by UE4 provides players with a realistic warship battleground. In the game, players drive their favorite warship search resources, strengthen the armed forces. They need to fight the enemy's sudden attack and defeat the opponent to survive to win the final victory. Giant sandbox and free exploration Free exploration in a vast area of up to 5200 square kilometers, avoid the dangerous waters shuttle between the islands and collect ammunition and materials to strengthen the warships. At any time the emergence of enemy warships foreshadowed the arrival of the crisis and the fierce artillery battle test the captain's technology and strategy. Desperate survival and winner is the king Warship survival 30 players drive warship in the magnificent sea field competition and in the despair of the final victory of the captain to become the champion. Nemesis circled Danger is everywhere in the game, not only the enemy warships looming, the storm circle gradually compressed the living space, but also the bombing circle erosion of safe sea. The players’ survival is greatly threatened. Special warship and competing in the sea Prince The attributes are balanced, the firepower is excellent, the maneuvering performance is good, the High rate of fire gun can fight continuously. It is capable of fighting in battle and is the backbone of the fleet. Chancellor It has the strongest armor, the heaviest artillery, the furthest range and a round of fire can seriously damage the enemy warship. It can be both front-line combat and rear support. Yugumo It has the strongest mobility, the furthest reconnaissance distance and grab the resources advantage significantly. If properly operated, it can successfully evade long-range artillery fire and can instantly sink enemy with stealthy torpedoes. Armored construction and inner core. Addition armor Each part of the warship has different armor values. Acceding to the difference in incident angle, the corresponding equivalent thickness can be generated to judge the breakdown or bounce. Additional armor absorbs some damage when it is broken, and also reduces the time it takes for the warship to catch fire. Inner core Warship structure restores the truth. Hit the core area will causes a lot of damage. Destruction of the magazine will result in a martyr burst. Resource contention and tactical battle Weapon and equipment The game has a wide variety of props, all types of warships have their own warship guns, sub-guns, torpedo launchers. They are providing a completely different firepower configuration. These weapons and equipment could boost the warship's powerful engines, provide armor for warship defense and fire protection. They can repair damage tubes of warship failure and upgrade the vessel for continuous operation. Special props Mines lurking at sea can cause warships to flood and catch fire. Not only can they carry out tactical support for bombing, but they can also search for enemy warships on a large scale. They show the intricacies of the sea war. Tactical and artillery Torpedoes can be used as conventional weapons, as well as tactical weapons to block the channel. When the warship is far away from the enemy, it needs to calculate the course and speed of the enemy for artillery bombardment. At this point, the difference in artillery directly affects the outcome of the battle. Ballistic camo shows individuality Cool ballistic Long-range artillery drags the gorgeous trajectory and making the relentless shelling a bright flower. Players can enjoy the joy of soaring in the sea from a ballistic perspective. Individual camo Sea camo makes it hard for the player to see the warship blend with the environment. Flowing camo can show the player’s personality significantly, but it is also because too bright and easy to be noticed by opponents. There’s always a variety of camo for players in the game. Season challenges and rich gameplay Battle Royale Both single and group can experience the exciting Battle Royale mode. In the sea where the strong enemy is seriating, the party that can survive will be rewarded handsomely by competing for supplies and fighting out of the siege. Team completion 30 players are made up of 10 teams and randomly assigned to two camps. .The two sides will fight with limited resources until all of them are sunk. Tactics and operational techniques will influence the final victory. Challenge Rewards Each match can gain combat experience to improve the game level. Completing missions and special challenges will earn battle level points and they will be able to exchange for a wealth of battle-level rewards. Players’ performance and results in battle will raise the individual rank to receive special rewards.
row.short_description: It's a warship survival TPS game with an exciting Battle Royale gameplay for solo players, teams and groups alike. Search for resources while sailing on the Crisis-ridden Sea. The last player standing becomes the King of the Sea!

row.name: Pixel Planner 📝
row.detailed_description: A simple, free and fun to use planner app with many features to help keep you on track, without taking up a whole screen to give you the information. Alarm - Can be used as a straight alarm, repeatable, or tuned as a custom pomodoro productivity timer with the rest function. Deadline - A constant reminder of how long is left to a critical date, ticking down in real time. Note - Leave a simple note for yourself. Checklist - Create a checklist of tasks. Bookmark - Create a quick link to an app on your computer, or to a website. Group - Tap windows together to link them to show relationships. Folder - Tap windows with this to store inside, then tap the [open] button to release them again. Palette - Change the colors by loading any 4 color texture
row.short_description: A simple to use planning app overlay, no need to dedicate a second monitor to your to do list, or only check it once a day. Have you checklist and deadline timer always visible and anywhere you like using the physics based placement system.

row.name: Aetheria Online
row.detailed_description: Aetheria is an MMORPG which focuses on challenging dungeons, cooperative group play, fast paced PvP, and important crafting elements. Aetheria utilizes action combat, which means no targeting and no standing still while casting, ever! This makes for an intense situation every battle, whether it be with other players or with fierce monsters. The land of Aetheria is unforgiving and harsh, so make sure to bring friends and guildmates on your journey. Dungeons Dungeons in Aetheria feature complex boss mechanics and require at least 5 players to defeat them (Some will require 10 or more!). The rewards are great, but failing to execute mechanics will result in death! Player vs Player Fighting other players in Aetheria can be done in a PvP arena or via Guild Wars. Combat is fast and requires quick reflexes to destroy your foes. If you are victorious, special rewards are bestowed upon you! Crafting Crafting is an important focus in Aetheria. Some of the most powerful weapons and armor can only be crafted. Crafting also is highly integrated into the progression of the story-line. Achievements Achievements are an extra milestone for players wanting to show off their skills in Aetheria. With categories ranging from Crafting and Exploration to Dungeons and Quests, there is a fun achievement for all types of players! Achievements also allow guilds to climb the ranks, as the total achievement points of all members influences your guild score! Costumes Costumes in Aetheria allow you to override the appearance of any of your current armor or weapons with any other piece of gear or costume item in the game. Customize away! Familiars Each class and specialization in Aetheria has a unique familiar which can be summoned to fight beside you in battle against other players or monsters. These little creatures can pack a punch, so make sure to utilize them at all times! Quests Aetheria features hundreds of quests which will require you to craft, kill, collect, interact, and much more. Rewards for completing quests are important and some are even necessary to enter various parts of the world! Guilds Conquer the world of Aetheria alongside your friends by creating or joining a guild! Guilds are a great way to keep in touch with friends. Guilds can also enter into war, making nearly every area of the world open for combat for warring members. War stats are tracked and even influence the rank of your guild. Other Features Over 2500 Unique Items Trading Parties Talent Trees 5 Unique Classes with 2 Specializations Each Frequent Updates
row.short_description: Aetheria is a 2D Action Combat MMORPG which focuses on challenging dungeons, cooperative group play, fast paced PvP, and important crafting elements.

row.name: Consolation: Board Meeting - Anthology Edition
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the BOARD: Thanks for checking out CONSOLATION: BOARD MEETING! Consolation: Board Meeting - Anthology Edtion is a series of anthological stories, delivered through a series of unique Multiplayer Party Games. There are currently 2 main game modes, with many mini-games and single-player options available. This game is constantly being updated, with more content to come at no additional cost! Each mode is packed full of Achievements and Secrets for those completionist achievement hunters out there! (Consolation: Board Meeting was originally created in 10 days for a Game Jam, but is slowly growing through continuous updates. Expect bugs!) *** Slasher Mode: Currently, there is only one Slasher mode map. Welcome to the Garnival! In this mode, one player (the host) must hunt down and kill the rest of the players before they can mount an escape. Guided by Emo Goose, players will unwrap the secrets of the Garnival. This mode is Halloween AND Christmas-themed, so it's perfect for year-round fun with friends and family. Tabletop Mode: There is currently only 1 board, and 5 minigames. However, you may find there is plenty of outcomes and content to enjoy! (Content is being added regularly, including in the Achieve Fear Update!) Can you discover all the secrets? Minigames can now be played offline in Practice mode! Access it anytime from the main menu. A Party Game above all else! Pick a name, or socialize using in-game chat. There is something for everyone to socialize and have a good time, with friends or with strangers. Primarily the MOUSE and WASD are used to traverse and control the game. Players can host a game using the Consolation Matchmaking services (Which are only accessible through an internet connection). Characters from other Sayincraft games and projects will guide you through the challenges you face ahead of you on the board. The game has a spinoff story in the unique (Sayincraft Studios created) CONSOLATION timeline, with a more dark yet comical take. A Dark-Comical Story You are an employee at the evil corporation, Consolation Innovations. You have been invited by the CEO, Christopher Conn to join him for a board meeting. There you learn you must compete in a series of challenges against fellow employees, presented as a board game, in order to climb the corporate ladder. Welcome aboard! Streamer Friendly! The game has many original and unique songs in its soundtracks catalog, one of which even has original lyrics based on the game's story and themes! Though it may seem off-putting to streamers, rest assured Sayincraft Studios owns and manages all songs used within the game. Should an issue arise, contact Sayincraft Studios directly and it will be solved promptly! :) Original Music, Art, and Talent! Consolation: Board Meeting features many original artistic works from many talents such as music by MojoKing, and Musithical. And visual art by Sheridan Animation student Bagged_Milkk. We are looking forward to everyone getting a chance to experience it all. (Click the artist's names to check them out!) Stay tuned for more updates, videos, and games from Sayincraft Studios! Also feel free to visit the official CONSOLATION: BOARD MEETING website, and join our community on the Official Discord! :D Remember, Everybody Needs a Little CONSOLATION
row.short_description: Welcome to Consolation: Board Meeting. This game is an anthology series of stories told through multiplayer party games. Hunt down geese as a disgruntled experiment, or participate in a board game- in a board meeting- for a promotion! No matter why you are here, welcome aboard!

row.name: Last Days Motel
row.detailed_description: Contact us QQ Group 820099460 This is Last Days Motel. A few survivors end up meeting here. Is it a new hope or just their final fate escaping from this cruel and relentless world? They will not give up and fighting against thier environment is the only option left! Today is the end of the world, but also the first day of your survival. By enjoying the first light of every new dawn and being optimistic, they begin to rebuild the motel, which is will be their only shelter in this unfriendly world as danger lurks around every corner. Step into the deadly environments and scavenge for food, water, energy and supplies to keep you alive. Everything has value in a world like this, even a broken and rusty can found in the trash can be useful. Collect whatever you can get and build all kinds of facilities to reinforce your motel. With these facilities, you will be able to provide invaluable supplies like medicine, weapons and armor to your team members; train and treat them whenever necessary. Again and again, you must brave the harsh expeditions searching for supplies, but be ready to encounter challenges from other survivors, whose target and goal is the same as yours. Perhaps, they are willing to share. Maybe, they are the only thing standing between you and those rare materials. Or, maybe there is more than that… Last Days Motel: where you simultaneously taste all the bitterness and sweetness from this wasteland. Come and join us in the fight! Early Access Features: The motel is your last shelter, build it however you like with different facilities to upgrade; Level up your characters through reading books and various trainings; Multiplayer PvP content – fight against other players in 5 different maps for supplies; A random forest map available for solo PVE.
row.short_description: In the doomsday Hotel, you can experience the hard life in the waste Land World. row.name: 東方翠神廻廊 〜 Faith in the Goddess of Suwa.
row.detailed_description: “Touhou Suijin Kairou” is a Touhou derivative RPG featuring over 150 fantasy girls! Explore the corridors and solve the strange situation in Gensokyo! A profound story unfolds, and your choices will change the future! Note We translate sentences in the game, store description using 'Google Translate'. Interface and character names are translated into English, but conversational sentences remain in Japanese. In addition, part of the picture of the character appearing in this game has a lot of skin exposure. Characters are not totally taken off, but the ratings are assumed to be over 12 years old. ◆Story◆ One rainy day, Gensokyo was covered in a verdant corridor. It was a fantasy labyrinth created by the overgrowth of trees and flowers, or the carelessly overlapping of terrain. In order to restore paradise, there were girls who challenged the corridor. Some monsters took this as an opportunity and attacked people in the corridors. A certain god calls back from a training trip a human man who once saved Gensokyo. Then the rain stopped and you returned to your fantasy. ◆Game explanation◆ ■Character Almost all of the more than 150 Touhou characters from the original work to Rainbow Cave will become friends. Not only male characters such as Rinnosuke who did not join your party in the previous work, Touhou Genmu Kairoku, but also you, the main character, can be included in your party as one of the characters. There are many ways to meet people, such as becoming friends through the story, or becoming friends after fighting together in the corridors. ■A mysterious flower Some fantasy girls can become ``mysterious flowers'' if they meet certain conditions. In this form, the girls' stats will greatly increase, their skills will be added, and, above all else, they will become voluptuous. It becomes huge or explosively big, and it becomes boing boing. ■Story In the story, you will be forced to make choices in multiple scenes, which will change the immediate aftermath and the likeability of the characters you will join. And depending on your choices, the outcome of the anomaly will change. Will you choose to solve the strange situation in Gensokyo, save the world, or fall into darkness? Which girl (virgin) will you choose to walk with? In addition, the story is connected to the previous works 'Touhou Magic Circle Continuous Strike' and 'Touhou Genmu Kairoku.' However, the story is enjoyable even if you have not played the Touhou original or the previous work and are starting with this work. ■Exploration You can control the main character and explore the map. The shape of the map changes constantly, like a mysterious dungeon. On the map, there are tools such as materials and money, light sources that light up when you get close to them, devices that activate, and magic circles that allow you to advance to the next floor or boss battle. You are not the only one wandering around the map; when you come into contact with a fairy, a battle begins, and when you meet a fantasy girl, events such as tool trading and battles begin. ■Battle Form a party of 5 people and fight against enemies. Battles are command battles in which you use 'techniques' to attack your opponent or assist your allies. You win if your opponent is wiped out, and you lose if your allies are wiped out. If you win, you can get experience points and tools, and if you lose, there is no penalty. ■Techniques This is a technique used in battle. There are a wide variety of effects, including techniques to attack the opponent, techniques to heal allies, techniques to change ability values, and techniques to revive a fully injured ally. Each character has completely different skills, and it seems that if certain conditions are met, you will be able to use the skills of other characters. ■Likeability Your favorability will increase by winning battles and giving gifts. As your favorability increases, your status will increase and you will be able to imprint powerful marks. Please note that favorability will not decrease. ■Gifts and spirit You can give a gift to the fantasy girl. Giving gifts will increase your spirit and favorability. By consuming energy, you can increase your level and favorability. ■Temperament Temperament (weather) may change due to rain or snow. Depending on the weather, exploring the corridors and fighting may become easier or more difficult. ■Light and darkness The light and darkness may change as the sun sets. Enemies are more likely to be encountered at dusk. Exploring the corridors will be difficult if the surroundings are shrouded in darkness. In Gensokyo, it seems that there is not only darkness, but also light and darkness surrounded by true darkness... ■Noh mask In the story, a divine spirit in the shape of a Noh mask appears. There are various Noh masks that will help you, trap you in the dream world, give you power as equipment, try to lead you to the light, and try to lead you into darkness. It seems that these Noh masks have a deep connection with the fantasy girl, and are closely related to this incident... ◆Replay elements◆ Score attacks are possible in some cases. Make your enemies as strong as possible and aim for a high score. There are also many leaderboards and 100 achievements. ◆Materials used◆ In creating this game, we borrowed many images and music materials. I would like to take this opportunity to thank you. The name of the author of the source material is listed in the 'Credit' section on the title screen of the game. ◆External link◆ Twitter Official Twitter: Official Twitter (for all ages): Hashtag: #東方翠神廻廊 #すいじん #thsuijin Discord ◆Disclaimer◆ ・This game is a derivative work of Touhou Project. ・This game is a completely free app, and there are no paid elements or advertisements. - Game specifications and difficulty level may change due to updates. - There is a save data export function, but we do not take any responsibility if the export fails. ・We do not take any responsibility if you are 'hit' on the mysterious flower. ・We do not take any responsibility if you encounter a spiritual disorder. ・There is no R18 element. (Tatemae) ■Ecchi element There are gal game (R12) elements such as favorability and gifts, but there are no ero game (R18) elements. There is a scene where the fantasy girls suddenly start playing 'danmaku', but since this is Gensokyo, it can't be helped, and 'playing bullet hell' is not a metaphor or allusion. Since it's all about older sisters, it's a gentle piece for gentlemen. (If it's just the appearance) Loli girls also appear. There is a scene where Tei supplements the confusing expressions in the story, but everything she says is true and there is not a single lie... that's what Tei said.
row.short_description: “Touhou Suijin Kairou” is a Touhou derivative RPG featuring over 150 fantasy girls! Explore the corridors and solve the strange situation in Gensokyo! A profound story unfolds, and your choices will change the future!
row.notes: As you progress through the game's story, characters will become friends, and some characters will be able to transform into big-breasted ladies. Although they are not completely naked, some characters do show a lot of skin. This game also has a strong focus on earthly desires. There are also some misleading sentences that arouse sexual desires. I'm assuming about R12.

row.name: Touhou Fantasia / 东方梦想曲
row.detailed_description: This game has only 1 stage and 1 player character. The length and difficulty of the game are similar to the extra stage of official Touhou games. One day a mysterious cat challenged Reimu in her dream. Despite the fact that the game style is highly similar to the official Touhou games, this is the first time that we try to switch to full HD resolution. To seek new possibilities for shmups, we also used Unity Engine with several popular technologies, such as 2D bones and dynamic materials. Due to the lack of difficulty options, this game can be difficult for beginners. Therefore, in this game, you can hold down Special button (C by default) to enable Auto Dodging without any limitation. However, Auto Dodging cannot solve all the problems, you have to use it wisely in order to beat this game.
row.short_description: This is a fan-made Touhou shmup with one single stage, similar to the extra stage of official Touhou games. This game has an auto dodging system, which gives you a choice to ignore all the danmaku and only focus on the story.

row.name: Aztec Tower
row.detailed_description: Aztec Tower is a free VR bow & arrow game about defending the temple of your people against the spanish conquistadors trying to take apart your sacred site to enrich themselves on the gold which they're ready to and already killed for. You're the last man standing of a brave tribe who fought against the invaders for generations. They're about to overrun your temple, but you're determined to take as many of them with you as you can. The game can be played on the HTC Vive through SteamVR. It should also run on the Oculus Rift or other VR headsets, but is only tested on the HTC Vive. Also please keep in mind that this game is not historically accurate nor is it trying to be. Textures, models and sounds of other creators were used. Please see ATTRIBUTION.txt in the game files for details. To reset your position in game, press and hold both thumb sticks on your controllers.

row.name: Wizard And Minion Idle
row.detailed_description: Wizard And Minion Idle is the newest free-to-play Idle Game to hit the market. With ever expanding limits according to your play style, the game allows you to dictate your own unique style of play. With challenges rising exponentially in both difficulty and reward, the user's style of play will influence how this game unfolds. No two people will make the same decisions, and no two users will have the same progression pace. It pays to grind, but sometimes it's easier to relax and just watch the rewards trickle in at your leisure. With additional games inside the actual game itself, there are plenty of reasons to invoke the age-old mantra of, '...just a little further'. -Spend experience earned for permanent bonuses -Souls are gained from nearly everything in the game -Train for combat -Cast powerful spells -Have demons do your bidding -Raise your minion -Experiment on and feed your minion to make him strong -Explore the wilds -Five Distinct Tiers of Loot! -Innovative Inventory ensures no item is worthless --Gather exotic materials --Craft magical gems --Catch strange fish -Artificially boost yourself -Master a myriad of dungeons -Unlock ever-expanding new content -Unlock even more content -Complete untold challenges -Defeat powerful bosses -Direct your legions in global warfare -Enjoy regularly and seasonally updated events -Die, reincarnate, and do it all again -Exit through the Soul and EXP shop, to spend your deserved rewards and become stronger. Through this cycle you will grow and a Champion shall rise! You start the game off a fresh initiate just beginning to realize your true potential. You're a wizard Steam player. In WAMI you will build your physical and sorcerous powers, weave game altering spells, and defeat fearsome enemies. Nourish your minion well, for your paths are intertwined. Your works in the mystic world will attract the attention of demons. Assign these demons based on your current in-game needs; Power, gold, magic and more. An intuitive gathering and crafting system allows you to further customize your wizard for the challenges ahead; with five different quality level of items available and a truly innovative inventory design, the possibilities are near endless! Rent structures, build golden plazas, drink from powerful elixirs to help you tarry on when sight of the goal is lost. Harvest experience points and soul shards to upgrade your wizard, allowing you to become the stuff of legends. You will come back to the world of WAMI again and again to complete regularly updated challenges and events for days and weeks to come! All is fair in love and war, So assign your legions of demons to all out warfare, or have them, well....attempt....to reproduce in order to gather the kinetic spirit needed to generate more power! This free to play Idle/active hybrid game has flexible pacing and a level of depth that will have you at wits end to push your limits to make it to the next level. Game-play and complexity unfolds at your level of play-style however, so you will never feel overwhelmed. ----Avid player's note ----Wizard and Minion Idle will snare you in, and after your first challenge, you will not want to leave. We haven't the time here, nor dared to delve into the darkest depths the developer has descended whenst he donned his digital undertaking. Start your adventure today to divine for yourself all the deeds described herein. Then do decide whether the delight known amicably as WAMI is indeed deserving the devotion of a daredevil who dared to download the distraction, the diversion; nay the duality of a demon fueled game known for the duration of decades as WIZARD AND MINiON IDLE
row.short_description: Train your stats, cast spells, feed your minion, defeat monsters and bosses, raise demons, craft gems, go fishing and so much more in Wizard and Minion Idle--WAMI. This free to play, solo developed, Idle/active hybrid game has flexible pacing for long-time play-ability.

row.name: flyingshapes
row.detailed_description: Design Entirely in Virtual Reality Create and shape industry-grade 3D models as if they were real objects right in front of you. Manipulate your design intuitively by moving the controllers in your hands. Don't waste any more time trying to find the perfect form of 3D objects on a 2D screen. You are now entering the world of flyingshapes°. Perfect for designing products and vehicles The creative workflow of flyingshapes° has been engineered specifically for designers of industrial objects, products and vehicles. Concept modeling and form finding have never been that intuitive. Start with a rough sketch in the virtual space around you. Thanks to VR even your very first drawing is already three-dimensional. From the very beginning onwards you experience all the dimensions of your object as if you were looking at a built prototype. Refine your design by adding lines, curves and surfaces. Shape your design with your hands by pushing here and pulling there using the controllers. Turn your object, move it around or lean over it to see it from your preferred angle. Whether you are designing an espresso machine or a skyscraper, you will love drawing in VR space. Invite other team-members, work with them via cloud and share your designs with people from all over the world. Export your 3D-models to industry-grade formats such as STEP, STL and others for convenient transfer to your 3D printer. Revolutionize your design-workflow with flyingshapes°, the easy-to-use design software that entirely reimagined CAD for virtual reality. Pricing This version of flyingshapes will offer you every feature available during a 30 day trial period. Afterwards you get access to the free version of flyingshapes that may be used for non-commercial use only. To get access to the commercial version of flyingshapes, please contact sales@flyingshapes.com
row.short_description: Experience VR design, a new way of creating your digital models for industrial design and architecture. Enjoy sketching and concept modeling in 3D space by simply moving the controllers in your hands. Design professional products with this intuitive app specifically tailored to virtual reality.

row.name: Arena of Shaelo
row.detailed_description: Arena of Shaelo is a pixelated co-op card game set in the world of Shaelo. Your somewhat cozy life in one of Shaelo's richer parts of the country, inhabited mainly by Squeans and occasional Swyrr migrants is interrupted by an arrival of a letter. Upon reading it, you learn that your uncle, now living at the other side of the kingdom, has fallen ill. Upon learning about your uncle's malady, you and your friend hastily set off to pay him a visit. Unfortunately, during your journey you are captured by one of countless Shaelo's dukes. Though suspected of plotting against the Z'buck race, you are given a chance to redeem your freedom. In order to do so, you have to defeat all the reigning champions of the Arena of Shaelo. Features 2-player couch CO-OP 3-4 hours of game-play Unique cards for both players Opening cards through progression Solid teamwork required in order to finish the game. As the game progresses you are required to play with different cards and switch between more various play styles. Increasing difficulty. As you progress, the round timer might change in order to make for a more challenging experience. Over 30 unlockable levels available 100% FREE, NO HIDDEN COSTS No secret level COUCH CO-OP ONLY 2 INPUT DEVICES REQUIRED TO PLAY ▽▽▽ SUPPORTED CONTROLLERS BELOW ▽▽▽ X-BOX GAMEPADS, KEYBOARD, MOUSE WARNING : This game is intended for 2 players, only that way you can fully experience the game of Shaelo ;)
row.short_description: Arena of Shaelo is a pixelated co-op card game set in the world of Shaelo. Once you begrudgingly take a step into the arena, it soon dawns on you that it is only through the power of teamwork that both you and your teammate might make it out alive.

row.name: Extraction Valley
row.detailed_description: New Game Mode Agents Gameplay Welcome Agents to Trifuel Alliance Extraction Valley Trifuel Alliance is the 2nd chapter of the Extraction Valley which takes place after the 1st Trifuel war. In the 1st war, Insurgents lost so many people. Since DWB used Advanced Robotics they kept pushing the SOA army back to their mainland. After countless losses, SOA wanted to expand its Trifuel mining operations so they ally with other factions. They call it Trifuel Alliance. Agents from all over the world were assigned to the extraction site to protect the harvester from any threat. DWB counter-attacked by cloning these agents and their abilities. DWB used them against the original agents who were assigned to protect the harvester and then the 2nd Trifuel war began. Gameplay Unlike our Previous game, Trifuel Alliance is not a Team Deathmatch game. Instead, we focus our game to be more tactical and your death has consequences if you downed, your team can revive you. but if they fall, you are dead. you have to wait until the next round starts to play. Extraction Valley Trifuel Alliance is a 4v4 PvP character base 3rd person shooter game where one team tries to defend the Trifuel Harvester while other team tries to destroy it. Players can choose an Agent to play before entering the match. Each Agent has a set of abilities that players can use. Each Agent has a role to play. There are 4 Agents to choose from. Wait for new agents in upcoming seasons. Destroy the Harvester 'Trifuel Alliance has deployed a Harvester to extract Trifuel'. As Westen Alliance, your objective is the destroy the harvester. Shoot at the harvester to damage it. Defend the Harvester 'Westen Alliance has deployed its agents to destroy our harvester Protected!' As Trifuel Alliance, your objective is to protect the Harvester. Use every weapon and abilities you have at your disposal. Servers Unlike Extraction Valley Devils' Curse, Trifuel Alliance doesn't use dedicated servers so you and your friends can host a match via steam and play. Players also can search for other's sections and join them.
row.short_description: Extraction Valley Trifuel Alliance is a 4V4 character base 3rd person shooter game. One team trying to protect a harvester while the other team tries to destroy it. Each Agent has a unique set of abilities that players can use.

row.name: Furs of Fury
row.detailed_description: Illustration by Ryan Francis Music by Caerus Writing by Brendan Bagley Creatures of the forest, unite! Rats run amok across the countryside. Demonic creeps roam the barren fields of our once lush woodland. The most peaceful of beasts are now brimming with FURY! The future of every beast is in your paws. Are you friend? Or are you fur? Victory is simple to grasp; destroy the enemy’s crystals and protect your own. Consider every unit in your arsenal: resourceful ants, healing lady bugs, savage spiders and many more. Plant healing herbs and fiery flowers to fend off pesky pests. Field the fauna that finish your foes the fastest. Assemble a roster of bugs and flowers to complement your own unique play style. Equip yourself from a wide variety of items inspired by classic literature, role-playing and real-time strategy games. Choose wisely: each player is limited to 6 items and 6 creatures.
